_comment: Physical left-to-right order of the machines as the audience sees them, per SPEC.md §24. Cascade and staggered takeover walk this array so the effect appears to travel across the room. Reordering the laptops on the table is a config edit, never a code change.
_stepMs: Milliseconds between adjacent nodes. 180 reads as a sweep; below ~90 it looks simultaneous, above ~400 it looks like lag.
_homeNode: Where JARVIS lives by default and where 'come back' returns it.
